description: Defines structures and classes for handling DNS response messages, including resource records, parsing, and response construction, as used in DNS protocol implementation.

classes.name: DnsResourceRecord
classes.description: Represents a DNS resource record as specified in RFC 1035, including fields for name, type, class, TTL, and RDATA.

classes.name: DnsRecordParser
classes.description: Iterator class for parsing resource records from a DNS response packet.

classes.name: DnsResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates a DNS response message, providing methods for construction, parsing, and access to header and resource records.

methods.name: DnsResourceRecord::SetOwnedRdata
methods.description: Sets the owned_rdata string and updates rdata to point to it.

methods.name: DnsResourceRecord::CalculateRecordSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the DNS resource record.

methods.name: DnsRecordParser::ReadName
methods.description: Parses a DNS name from the packet, handling compression.

methods.name: DnsRecordParser::ReadRecord
methods.description: Parses the next resource record from the packet.

methods.name: DnsResponse::InitParse
methods.description: Initializes parsing of the response buffer and validates against a DNS query.

methods.name: DnsResponse::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the DNS response is valid after parsing.
